Specification: This module specifies and proves properties of a reusable barrier synchronization algorithm for N concurrent processes using two gates and a lock. The PlusCal algorithm models a two-chamber barrier in which processes first accumulate in a first waiting chamber, then pass through a second waiting chamber, preventing any process from re-entering the barrier too early and overtaking others. The translated TLA+ specification defines the operational steps a0 through a12, proves type correctness, mutual exclusion in the lock-protected critical section, several barrier invariants and a flush invariant, and finally proves that the detailed barrier implementation refines an abstract instantiated Barrier specification through a translated program counter view.

LEMMA ProcSetSubSetsBound ==
    /\ IsFiniteSet(ProcsInRdv) /\ Cardinality(ProcsInRdv) \in 0..N
    /\ IsFiniteSet(ProcsInB1) /\ Cardinality(ProcsInB1) \in 0..N
    /\ IsFiniteSet(ProcsInB1)' /\ Cardinality(ProcsInB1)' \in 0..N
    /\ IsFiniteSet(ProcsInB2) /\ Cardinality(ProcsInB2) \in 0..N
    /\ IsFiniteSet(ProcsInB2)' /\ Cardinality(ProcsInB2)' \in 0..N

LEMMA AllProcsInRdv == 
    (Cardinality(ProcsInRdv) = N) => (\A p \in ProcSet : rdvsection(p))

THEOREM FS_NonEmptySet ==
    ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
    PROVE Cardinality(S) > 0 <=> \E x: x \in S

THEOREM FS_TwoElements ==
    ASSUME NEW S, IsFiniteSet(S)
    PROVE Cardinality(S) > 1 => \E x, y \in S: x # y

THEOREM BarrierExclusion ==
    Inv => \/ ~(\E p \in ProcSet: pc[p] \in {"a0", "a1", "a2", "a3", "a4"})
           \/ ~(\E p \in ProcSet: pc[p] \in {"a7", "a8", "a9", "a10"})

THEOREM BarrierExclusion2 ==
    TypeOK /\ Inv => 
      \/ (\A p \in ProcSet: pc[p] \in 
                    {"a5", "a6", "a7", "a8", "a9", "a10", "a11", "a12"})
      \/ (\A p \in ProcSet: pc[p] \in 
                    {"a11", "a12", "a0", "a1", "a2", "a3", "a4", "a5", "a6"})
IfThenElse:
IF rdv = N
                  THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "a4"]
                  ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "a5"]

IF rdv = 0
                  THEN /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "a10"]
                  ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "a11"]

IF pc[self] \in {"a1", "a2", "a3", "a4", "a5", "a6", "a7", "a8", "a9", "a10"}
    THEN "b1"
  ELSE IF pc[self] = "a0" 
    THEN "b0"
  ELSE IF gate_2 > 0
    THEN "b0"
  ELSE "b1"

IF pc[self] = "a0" 
    THEN "b0"
  ELSE IF gate_2 > 0
    THEN "b0"
  ELSE "b1"
